'terastallize' changes a Pokemon's defensive typing to solely their tera type, meaning their resistances and weaknesses can change. It also gives them a boost to moves of their new typing. You can only 'terastallize' one Pokemon per battle, and it will last on that Pokemon until they are KO'd or the battle ends. You can choose to 'terastallize' and use another move in the same turn.
